## Purpose

Describe the smallest useful change.

## Evidence and provenance

- What source, observation, decision, or issue supports it?
- Which statements remain uncertain?
- Does the change reproduce or adapt third-party material?

## Checks

- [ ] Internal links still resolve.
- [ ] Contact addresses are not exposed before testing.
- [ ] No credentials, private evidence, or raw media were added.
- [ ] British English is used unless the source requires another language.
- [ ] New images include rights information and alt text.
- [ ] Canonical ANHQV-TS2 records remain in the project repository.
